title: F8 reliability
caption: The SDK already retries a busy moment before a stream; F8 adds the case inside it, before any words, and says an account limit plainly to the chat and the evals.

cards.title: A busy moment retried, a limit said plainly
cards.text: Asked again only before any words; an account limit stops work at once, with when it lifts.

cards.title: What the SDK already does
cards.text: A 429 or 529 before the stream is retried; a 400 is not.

cards.title: The gap
cards.text: An overload inside a stream, before any words, fails at once.

cards.title: A failure's kind
cards.text: The provider says what is worth asking again, and what is an account limit.

cards.title: Retry before any words
cards.text: Backoff, logged, never after content, never an account limit.

cards.title: The chat
cards.text: The reason in words, and when access comes back.

cards.title: The evals
cards.text: A run stops at the first limit, the agent's or the judge's.
